summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill addressing trace context cleanup during Client re-initialization—a specific teardown operation triggered by API key change. It does not semantically match any existing skill: it is narrower and more specialized than 'End Trace and Finalize' (which is general-purpose trace termination), orthogonal to 'Start Trace Session' and 'Update Trace Metadata' (which are setup/execution stage), and unrelated to dataset filtering or async result retrieval. The peer candidates represent the broader trace_management task_family but none capture the re-initialization-specific cleanup logic, constraints, or cautions. No conflict evidence exists. This warrants a new distinct capability.
